rationale: Scope was triaged by feasibility before the competition closed. A typed 2-3 hop metapath index plus specificity and evidence features plus evaluation on existing splits was judged feasible in 3-5 hours; LLM plausibility scoring at scale, NBFNet/BioPathNet training, soft proof aggregation and a faithfulness study were not.
subject: P-17
title: Path/semantics MVP is a few hours; the full program is not
